name: Kickbox Open (free disposable-domain check)
operator: Kickbox, Inc. (kickbox.com; the open.kickbox.com page reads 'Powered by Kickbox')
tier_rationale: Established e-mail verification company with a published Master Services Agreement, a privacy policy and paid plans (A8 trusted). Only a domain is ever sent (never an address), so the provider receives IOC values only.

reliability.justification: Curated disposable-domain list behind a single boolean; answers {'disposable': false} even for invalid input (observed 2026-11-26), so it is a second opinion only, never ground truth.

disposable.title: Kickbox Open GET /v1/disposable/{domain} (domain only)

terms.quote: Free Disposable Email Address Check API - Powered by Kickbox ... The software is provided "as is" and "as and when available", without warranty of any kind
terms.reviewer: p1-G04-1 implementer (P088 C5: terms recorded per provider before use)

disposable.notes: Research C0218 (verified_live 200, 0.23-0.51 s, no rate-limit headers). The open endpoint publishes no usage terms of its own: the page states only a warranty disclaimer, and Kickbox's Master Services Agreement (https://docs.kickbox.com/docs/terms-of-service, checked 2026-11-26) covers the paid services, so the class stays 'unknown' (A1: terms not published) until legal reviews it; email_hygiene_online then skips this feed under the corporate profile (aggregator filter) and still asks MailCheck.ai. Only the normalised domain is sent, never the address (P088 C5). Quota: 'fair use' without a published figure - 500/day is a conservative local budget.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G04-1 (P088 email_hygiene_online). Disify is deliberately not used (it needs the full address and flagged example.com as disposable, P088 C5).
